name: Alaric's Remains
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Alaric's bones lie far from the Fenris Isle he called home. His spirit asks travelers to carry them past the Rot Hide gnolls and into Fenris Keep.

sections.title: A Final Request
sections.body: Alaric's bones were unearthed from a shallow grave in Silverpine Forest. He once lived on Fenris Isle and cherished the place. Now his spirit asks whoever finds his bones to leave behind his ill-fitting boots and carry his remains directly into Fenris Keep, beyond the reach of mainland scavengers.

sections.title: The Alcove in the Keep
sections.body: Alaric guides the carrier to Fenris Keep's southwestern tower, past the infested lower grounds and into a quiet chamber. Behind a dusty shelf, a hidden niche holds an artifact once valued by Thule Ravenclaw and his fellow mages. In return for a quiet resting place beyond the Rot Hide gnolls, Alaric gives the hidden trinkets to those who carry his bones home.

faq.answer: Alaric once lived in Fenris Keep and considered those the finest days of his life. After his death, he was buried in a shallow grave in Silverpine Forest. Now his spirit asks a passerby to carry his bones home.

faq.q: Where are Alaric's remains supposed to go?
faq.answer: Alaric's remains belong in a concealed alcove behind a dusty shelf in the southwestern tower of Fenris Keep on Fenris Isle.

faq.q: Why does Alaric want his remains sealed behind a shelf?
faq.answer: Fenris Keep brought Alaric comfort in life, and he wants to rest within its stone walls instead of in a dirt ditch. He also wants the alcove sealed to protect his bones from the Rot Hide gnolls roaming the keep.

faq.q: Why did he say to leave his boots behind?
faq.answer: Alaric said his boots never fit him in life, so he asked that they be left behind when his bones were carried from the shallow grave.

faq.q: What is inside the hidden alcove besides a resting place?
faq.answer: The hidden niche holds an item once treasured by Thule Ravenclaw and his former associates, along with magical belongings Alaric gives to anyone who carries his remains to rest.

angles.text: As a Forsaken traveler, you may understand a spirit whose mortal rest was disturbed. Alaric seeks peaceful seclusion, not service under the Dark Lady.
As a mage, you may recognize the cache Alaric reveals as relics connected to Thule Ravenclaw and the Dalaran-trained arcanists who once studied and schemed inside Fenris Keep.
